decisions.reason: The source changes About-page copy, not the independently scoped FAQ content; overlapping descriptions do not require the FAQ to change.
The source raises but does not resolve automatic transfer versus manual claiming, and the candidate already records that same-message uncertainty as an AMBIGUOUS Event.
The Aave yield requirement is already directly introduced from this same message with the stated provider and deposit-based yield mechanism.
The source restates the existing no-code allocation of the commission and tickets to a random existing holder without changing its trigger, recipient, or reward components.
The source does not address which book, referral-code, badge, or ticket state transfers when an NFT is resold.
The source repeats the existing $15 mint price and $5 referral commission but does not change the founder allocation, fee handling, or residual prize-pool allocation.
Chainlink VRF selection and ticket-weighted chances are restated consistently with the candidate's existing state and introduce no changed selection rule.
The About-page copy restates the existing five $10,000 prizes around every 50,000 mint or secondary sales and does not necessarily change the Big Block mechanism.
Mentioning secondary sales as prize-draw sales does not change the royalty amount, visibility, founder share, pool destinations, or ticket-creation rule.
The About-page copy restates the existing five $500 prizes around every 500 mint or secondary sales and does not necessarily change the Small Block mechanism.
The statement that the mint number is the referral code is already represented, while the source does not change metadata counter or badge visibility.
Generic About-page references to badges and leaderboards do not change the approved badge set, icons, milestones, storage, or current effect.
